definition: A withholding certificate completed by a foreign individual to establish nonresident alien status and claim reduced withholding rates or exemptions on U.S. source income, or to document foreign status for financial account purposes.

includes.text: Form identifies the beneficial owner as a nonresident alien individual
includes.quote: Establish that you are not a U.S. person

includes.text: Form requests country of citizenship and permanent residence address
Form includes certification section requiring signature and date
includes.quote: Form W-8BEN must be signed and dated by the beneficial owner

excludes.text: Sibling is used by U.S. persons and citizens to document U.S. status
excludes.quote: You are a U.S. citizen (even if you reside outside the United States) or other U.S. person (including a resident alien individual). Instead, use Form W-9

excludes.text: Sibling is used to report foreign earned income of U.S. citizens or residents abroad
Sibling is a worksheet or computation form for qualified business income deduction
excludes.quote: Qualified Business Income Deduction Simplified Computation

discriminators.text: This form certifies foreign nonresident alien status for withholding purposes; the sibling documents U.S. person status and requests taxpayer identification number
discriminators.quote: Establish that you are not a U.S. person

discriminators.text: This form is a withholding certificate for foreign individuals on U.S. source income; the sibling is a tax return reporting foreign earned income of U.S. citizens or residents
discriminators.quote: Certificate of Foreign Status of Beneficial Owner for United States Tax Withholding and Reporting

discriminators.text: This form is a withholding certificate for individuals; the sibling is a computation worksheet for calculating qualified business income deduction
